commentary_segments.text: In this Chapter the trade offs between standard CMOS and BiCMOS are also discussed. This is why some known schematics are also included. Most of the discussion is on the symmetrical OTA and the folded cascode OTA as they are so often used. Finally, a list of published opamps are discussed to show that the design principles are applicable to most of them. We recall the simplest differential voltage amplifier that we have observed.
